summary: Lucy possesses an uncanny ability to perceive flavors and aromas. When her cherished restaurant replaces its kitchen crew, she cannot identify the chef responsible for the dishes she has long adored. A chance meeting with two former chefs inspires her to track down their old colleagues.
culinary_description: Strong culinary themes centered on a restaurant, kitchen crew, and a protagonist with an uncanny ability to perceive flavors and aromas.
fantasy_description: No explicit fantasy elements. The story is primarily romance and culinary.
relevance: Medium - strong culinary themes but limited fantasy elements.

title: Cheffy the Chef
author: WaterDrop (Avital)
summary: Welcome to the ultimate cook show, starring the ultimate host and master of the kitchen: Cheffy the Chef! Cheffy and leMouse embark on adventures to prepare exquisite dishes. Features cats, mouse, smores, and cookies.
culinary_description: Strong culinary themes centered on a cooking show host and master of the kitchen. Adventures preparing exquisite dishes including s'mores and cookies.
fantasy_description: Fantasy elements with anthropomorphic characters (cats, mice) and magical cooking adventures.
relevance: Medium-High - culinary fantasy with cooking show adventures.

title: RE-BITE - The psychotic Chef
author: VirusZeke
summary: A horror comic following married gay protagonists who kill and devour victims. Louise races to become a professional chef and win a cooking tournament. Features bi-monthly cooking battle seasons and high-level cooking classes.
culinary_description: Professional chef aspirations, cooking tournaments, high-level cooking classes, and group-based cooking battles.
fantasy_description: Minimal fantasy elements. Psychological horror with a culinary setting.
relevance: Medium - strong culinary themes (cooking tournaments) but horror-focused rather than fantasy.
